title: MeshSync Thumbnails Extension
description: Thumbnail references generated by worker-thumbnail-generation pipeline

v1.description: Version 1 of the thumbnails extension schema

static.description: Reference to a static thumbnail image in resources/ (e.g., sha256:abc123...def.jpg)

animated_360.description: Reference to an animated 360° preview in resources/ (e.g., sha256:ghi789...jkl.mp4)

glb_preview.description: Reference to a glTF binary preview in resources/ (e.g., sha256:mno012...pqr.glb)
